method_selected_rationale: 16 candidate (14 dynamic + 2 fallback) 비교 후 Diebold-Mariano SR diff test (Memmel 2003 closed form) ALL p > 0.05. ΔSR DM t > 2 + Δ MDD <= 2pp + Turnover_yr <= 30% strict improve criterion 미달. R12 No Silent Override 정합 — 조용한 dynamic adoption 거부. Static admit (50/25/20/5) retain. 본 결과는 도훈 mandate '레짐이나 해당시점 리스크기반 동적비중조절 방법론' 정직 답변: 현 sample (256m str1715 backbone + 135m joint TSMOM) 에서 paradigm-free static convergence가 statistically dominant. NOTE: 'N=256 power 충분' 표현은 부정확 — DM power calc effect size 0.05 + var 0.0169 + n=256 → power ≈ 0.20 부족. NS 결론 자체는 valid (p=0.51 명백 NS).
method_2nd_rationale: CRISIS regime aggressive shift (str1715 -20pp / kr10y +10pp / tsmom +5pp / cash +5pp). 256m SR_net 1.9090 vs baseline 1.8603 (ΔSR +0.0487 NS p=0.51 t=0.654). MDD -14.51% vs -15.23% (-0.72pp 개선) — bootstrap 95% CI [-0.22, -0.07] baseline -15.23% 포함 → statistically indistinguishable. CVaR_95 5.07% vs 5.51% (-0.44pp). GFC 2008 sub-period cumulative +10.50% vs +6.95% (+3.55pp 명확 우월). DM test NS but risk-mgmt 측면 strong. Future research: sample 확장 시 sig 도달 여부 재평가.
method_3rd_rationale: CRISIS shift str1715 -10pp / kr10y +5pp / tsmom +5pp. 256m SR_net 1.8924 (ΔSR +0.032 NS p=0.37). Turnover 9.4% vs 18.8% (09_aggr). 보수적 dynamic 변형.
